market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Iran war escalation keeps oil elevated and inflation fears front-of-mind. S&P 500 finding support after 3-day skid via bargain buying, but upside capped by Fed hawkishness (Barr). Tech leads recovery on AI capex strength. Expect 2-3% range-bound trading with oil as swing factor. Yen intervention risk adds FX volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex supercycle (NVIDIA, Dell, TSMC) supports tech earnings through 2027. K-shaped economy persists: premium consumer and digital payments outperform, lower-income discretionary lags. EM favors India/Singapore. Solid-state batteries (QuantumScape) and robotaxi (Waymo, Zoox) are 2027 catalysts. Fed path depends on oil trajectory post-Iran.
